scope: Individually authored exterior details on selected existing frontages. Source dates vary; this is not a complete contemporary survey or a measured digital twin. No source-photo pixels redistributed.

a109.captureDate: 2024-12 (month stated in article; exact day not stated)
a109.rights: Observation only; photograph not redistributed or used as a texture.
a109.observations: Tall narrow corner facade with dark inset vertical windows; long return on E7; squared shallow parapet projections; salmon awnings and Miss Lily’s fascia; sidewalk tables.

a112.captureDate: 2024-12 (month stated in article; exact day not stated)
a112.rights: Observation only; photograph not redistributed or used as a texture.
a112.observations: Corner entrance up shallow stone step; black wood/glass bays; black fire escape; boxy projecting white NIAGARA sign with black lettering. Joe Strummer mural is on E7 return, vivid blue portrait on orange/yellow/red background.

a113.captureDate: 2024-12 (month stated in article; exact day not stated)
a113.rights: Observation only; photograph not redistributed or used as a texture.
a113.observations: Narrow, densely stickered serving frontage. Broad illustrated mint-green sign with red/yellow Ray’s Candy Store lettering; illustrated ice-cream cones below glazing; projecting white side sign for Belgian fries; black fire escape overhead. Residential entrance left of store.

a115.rights: Observation only; photograph not redistributed or used as a texture.
a115.observations: Silver aluminum-framed tall display window left and glass door right; one shallow black/yellow-edged entry step; black bench. Forest-green rectangle with large white outlined MAYA; small yellow California-Style Taqueria lettering and yellow corner motifs; three black gooseneck lights.

a117.captureDate: 2024-12 (month stated in article; exact day not stated)
a117.rights: Observation only; photograph not redistributed or used as a texture.
a117.observations: Centered green multi-pane double doors and transom; one tall framed window each side; narrow dark rectangular sign with thin gold serif ST DYMPHNAS; black fire-escape platform spans above.

a119.captureDate: 2024-12 (month stated in article; exact day not stated)
a119.rights: Observation only; photograph not redistributed or used as a texture.
a119.observations: Broad white lightbox with large red RESTAURANT; small black SUPERIORITY BURGER below. Perpendicular rectangular white message-board sign with black changeable letters. Dark doors/glazing separated by chunky piers. Black exterior escape balcony directly above signage.

a121.captureDate: 2020-05 (article published May 28; exact capture day unstated)
a121.rights: Observation only; photograph not redistributed or used as a texture.
a121.observations: Long vivid-blue fascia with large white LUSTER over PHOTO & DIGITAL LAB; silver aluminum shop frame, low opaque panels, tall display windows and entry slightly right of center. Black fire escape crosses upper windows.

a135.captureDate: 2025-03 publication-proximate; exact capture date not established
a135.rights: Observation only; photograph not redistributed or used as a texture.
a135.observations: Narrow central open doorway with red-painted jambs. Large glazed windows either side behind folding diamond-pattern security grilles. Plain glossy black fascia with peach/pink cursive Lucy’s script centered high.

a141.rights: Observation only; photograph not redistributed or used as a texture.
a141.observations: Wraparound burgundy rounded awning with spaced white DOC HOLLIDAY’S BAR lettering and 141 address. Stickered entry, dark corner windows, black iron fire escape directly above. E9 return has orange-red mural of four Old West figures and big blue Doc Holliday’s text.

a145.rights: Observation only; photograph not redistributed or used as a texture.
a145.observations: Long cobalt-blue fascia, white central panel with red/yellow cursive Ralph’s. White ITALIAN ICES and ICE CREAM side lettering; central serving opening with large menu panels at each side; black/dark windows above, some air conditioners. Hydrant and yellow/blue vending box at left.

a147.rights: Observation only; photograph not redistributed or used as a texture.
a147.observations: Circular cobalt-blue projecting disk sign with white BABA DONER and Traditional Kebab around kebab icon. Dark glazing, right-side recessed glass door, simple dark wood bench; sidewalk shed obscures upper facade.

a149.rights: Observation only; photograph not redistributed or used as a texture.
a149.observations: Narrow glass door to left up concrete step; outward projecting display window to right, three planes and deep sill; simple wood bench; Retail For Lease notice in large window. Small white BLANK STREET text on door.

a151.captureDate: 2025-07 publication; photo appears to be colder-season file shot (exact capture unknown)
a151.rights: Observation only; photograph not redistributed or used as a texture.
a151.observations: Horizontal oval projecting illuminated sign with red DANNY & COOP’S and CHEESESTEAKS. Silver perforated/slotted roller shutter. Traditional gold-toned entry lantern; black fire escape overhead.

a165.rights: Observation only; photograph not redistributed or used as a texture.
a165.observations: Repeated thin ornamental lintels and small diamond masonry details between floors; black zigzag fire escape spans two central windows. Cream rectangular sign with dark burgundy stacked name and round bagel logos. Burgundy retractable awning and circular projecting logo. Residential door numbered 165 at left; broad shop opening right.

a169.rights: Observation only; photograph not redistributed or used as a texture.
a169.observations: Wide six-panel folding wood/glass doors with high transom lights and inset plywood-like lower panels. Broad pale oval sign with pink/yellow cursive illuminated Lucinda’s, small HONKY TONK/JUKE JOINT/COCKTAILS/MUSIC. Pale yellow fire-escape platform above; separate narrow black building entry at left numbered 169.

a166.captureDate: 2024-12 (month stated in article; exact day not stated)
a166.rights: Observation only; photograph not redistributed or used as a texture.
a166.observations: Bold black negative-space PEACE letterforms in long white fascia. Ground-floor frontage protected by thin white vertical bars; plants and old metal containers stand in front; narrow glazed/door openings behind. Upper windows have pale rectangular frames.

a170.rights: Observation only; photograph not redistributed or used as a texture.
a170.observations: Observed August entry: recessed double glass doors, dark charcoal boxed reveals, tall clear transom; maroon scalloped awning with white rabbit-on-books icon, white The Rabbit and large Books and Bar lettering. Earlier 2025 full corner photo establishes long wraparound display glazing and red brick upper floors with ornate pale lintels/fire escapes.

tile.observations: Blue awning with narrow light stripes and right-aligned TILE BAR; green left recessed door numbered 115; wide low two-pane window; orange-red ground paint and patches of green/purple tile; red round bistro tables and folding chairs; freestanding chalkboard; illuminated beer lettering in window.

hen.observations: Black surround with orange illuminated cursive Hen House NYC; pale blue circular projecting sign; glazed transom over dark metal storefront. Article address is 120 First Avenue.

yubu.observations: Very narrow brown timber/glass storefront; door on left and display glazing on right; wall air conditioner over left; raised red awning with white YUBU; small folding table on sidewalk.

nudibranch.observations: Lowercase dark nudibranch applied directly to glazing; smaller 125 1st Ave below. No solid fascia established by this cropped photograph.

building-241822226.rights: Village Preservation archive; observation only; image not redistributed.
building-241822226.observations: Two upper bays on First Avenue; longer East 7th elevation has irregularly spaced openings, much plainer lintels, a flat parapet and no front escape. Avenue-facing frame and lintels dark brown. Ground-level corner tiled paint survives in the later Tile Bar photo.

building-248142707.rights: Village Preservation archive; observation only; image not redistributed.
building-248142707.observations: Five-story red-brick corner; seven upper window openings across First Avenue, dark brown trim and a deep black cornice. East 7th has a broad white blind panel by the corner and sparse dark-trim windows beyond. Historical FOOD MARKET signage is not current occupancy evidence.

building-241829631.rights: Village Preservation archive; observation only; image not redistributed.
building-241829631.observations: Five-story painted-red brick corner with three First Avenue window stacks, long East 7th return, pale flat lintels, dark sashes and a stepped red-brown roof cornice. Side fire escape is visible toward the western part of East 7th. Old bodega sign is not current evidence.

building-248142331.rights: Village Preservation archive; observation only; image not redistributed.
building-248142331.observations: Five-story narrow brick elevation with three windows, red fire escape centered across the openings, broad pale lintels and a plain roof edge with metal roof railing.

building-248142715.rights: Village Preservation archive; observation only; image not redistributed.
building-248142715.observations: Five-story red-brick tenement with three bay groups, russet escape, heavy dark bracketed cornice and pale window surrounds. Old shop identities are not used as current names.

irving.rights: Existing observation metadata; photograph not redistributed.
irving.review: Existing September 6 observation reused; no new photo inspection claimed.

casey.rights: Existing observation metadata; photograph not redistributed.
casey.review: Existing September 6 observation reused; no new photo inspection claimed.

baths.rights: Existing observation metadata; photograph not redistributed.
baths.review: Existing September 6 observation reused; no new photo inspection claimed.

building-248142404.rights: Observation only. Photograph not redistributed or used as a game texture.
building-248142404.observations: Four stories, two avenue windows per upper floor, buff brick below exposed red-brick parapet band, black window frames and grilles. Lower than neighboring 114. Fire escape is on East 7th return, not on the avenue. Side window positions are partly occluded.

saifee-2025.rights: Observation only. Photograph not redistributed or used as a game texture.
saifee-2025.observations: Front view confirms the two different building heights, buff brick at 116 and painted red at 114, red escape, broad tapered lintels, roof railing and plants. Continuous brown awning carries white Saifee / hardware & garden lettering; smaller Ralph Lauren Paint and California Paints marks. String lights run over both facades; metal shutters and fluorescent shop lights are visible.

saifee-2024-night.rights: Observation only. Photograph not redistributed or used as a game texture.
saifee-2024-night.observations: Wide front confirms two linked shops, large silver-framed windows, left doorway at 116 and right doorway at 114, dense plants and ceramic stock, blue wheeled racks, warm strings hung across both heights.

saifee-2024-plants.rights: Observation only. Photograph not redistributed or used as a game texture.
saifee-2024-plants.observations: Daylight close view: weathered brown fabric awning, exposed support tubes and light bulbs, trailing hanging baskets, tall foliage in a terracotta square planter, six-level blue-and-galvanized wheeled plant rack, small pots and cacti, neon OPEN panel and window notices.

e7-2024.rights: Observation only. Photograph not redistributed or used as a game texture.
e7-2024.observations: Black horizontal-slatted fascia wraps around corner. Raised white DELI & CAFE letters, red E and green 7 on black logo panels. Small white category labels and 118 number. Recessed avenue doorway, black-and-white geometric door reveal, aluminum threshold, food-image decals, a Plant-based menu A-board, narrow return window and adjacent blue mural.

smoke-exterior.publisher: E Smoke & Convenience photographs, hosted by Vapersmap
smoke-exterior.rights: Observation only. Photograph not redistributed or used as a game texture.
smoke-exterior.observations: Raised red letters with black returns on a pale gray fascia; a narrow red category strip below. Ribbed canopy soffit, narrow dark mullions, a large densely stocked display window to left and glass door to right. Visible horizontal shelves, packaged products, bottles, fluorescent strips and entry rail.

monkey-2025.rights: Observation only. Photograph not redistributed or used as a game texture.
monkey-2025.observations: Monkey Sushi replaced the earlier Unique Omakase identity at 120 / 120½ First Avenue. See photographed exterior for the individually modeled sign, entry, fixtures and window artwork.

burger-2021.rights: Observation only. Photograph not redistributed or used as a game texture.
burger-2021.observations: Small storefront at 91 East 7th Street, at east end of 118 First building. Door, glazing, over-window lettering and exterior seating observed in opening photographs. Current exact stickers and furniture layout unverified.
